# `<sl-file-drop>` — File Drop

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

File drops let users pick files by dragging them onto a zone or by browsing, e.g. to attach documents or import a signed version.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/file-drop/file-drop.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-format-bytes>`, `<sl-icon>`, `<sl-icon-button>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | — | `string` | `''` | The file drop's label. If you need to display HTML, use the `label` slot instead. |
| `help-text` | `helpText` | `string` | `''` | The file drop's help text. If you need to display HTML, use the `help-text` slot instead. |
| `hint` | — | `string` | `''` | A short line inside the drop zone that states the limits, e.g. "PDF or DOCX, up to 20 MB". |
| `accept` | — | `string` | `''` | The file types to accept, in the same format as the `accept` attribute of a file input: a comma-separated list of extensions (`.pdf`), MIME types (`application/pdf`) or wildcards (`image/*`). Files that don't match are rejected. |
| `multiple` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Allows more than one file. Without it, each new file replaces the previous one. |
| `disabled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the file drop. |
| `max-file-size` | `maxFileSize` | `number` | — | The largest file allowed, in bytes. Larger files are rejected. |
| `max-files` | `maxFiles` | `number` | — | The most files the list can hold when `multiple` is set. Files beyond the limit are rejected. |
| `hide-file-list` | `hideFileList` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the built-in file list, e.g. when you render upload progress yourself. |
| `remove-label` | `removeLabel` | `string` | `'Remove'` | The label of each file's remove button, followed by the file name. Set it to localize the component. |

## Properties without an attribute

These can only be set from JavaScript: `element.prop = value`, `[prop]="value"` in Angular, `.prop=${value}` in Lit. Writing them as HTML attributes does nothing.

| Property | Type | Notes | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | `File[]` |  | The files the user has picked. You can also set it, e.g. to clear the list after an upload. |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-change` | — | Emitted when files are added or removed by the user. |
| `sl-file-reject` | `{ rejections: { file: File, reason: 'type' \| 'size' \| 'count' }[] }` | Emitted when one or more files are turned away because they don't match `accept`, exceed `max-file-size` or go over `max-files`. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `browse()` | Opens the browser's file picker. |
| `clear()` | Removes every file from the list. Does not emit `sl-change`. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `label` | The file drop's label. Alternatively, you can use the `label` attribute. |
| `instructions` | The text inside the drop zone. Use it to localize or reword the default text. |
| `icon` | The icon inside the drop zone. |
| `help-text` | Text that describes how to use the file drop. Alternatively, you can use the `help-text` attribute. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `form-control` | The form control that wraps the label, drop zone, file list and help text. |
| `form-control-label` | The label's wrapper. |
| `form-control-help-text` | The help text's wrapper. |
| `base` | The drop zone, a `<button>` element. |
| `icon` | The container that wraps the drop zone's icon. |
| `instructions` | The container that wraps the drop zone's text. |
| `hint` | The hint under the instructions. |
| `file-list` | The list of selected files. |
| `file` | Each file in the list. |
| `file-type` | The badge showing a file's extension. |
| `file-name` | A file's name. |
| `file-size` | A file's size. |
| `remove-button` | A file's remove button, an `<sl-icon-button>` element. |

## Documentation and examples

The whole zone is a button: users can click it, focus it and press <kbd>Enter</kbd>, or drop files onto it. The picked
files are available in the `files` property and are listed under the zone.

```html
<sl-file-drop label="Attachments" hint="PDF, DOCX or DWG, up to 20 MB" multiple></sl-file-drop>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/file-drop/file-drop.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-file-drop-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `<sl-file-drop label="Attachments" hint="PDF, DOCX or DWG, up to 20 MB" multiple></sl-file-drop>`
})
export class FileDropExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### Accepting files

`accept` takes the same format as a file input: extensions, MIME types or wildcards. Files that don't match, that are
larger than `max-file-size` (in bytes) or that go over `max-files` are turned away, and `sl-file-reject` tells you which
ones and why. Show the reasons to the user, e.g. in an [alert](alert.md).

```html
<div class="file-drop-rules">
  <sl-file-drop
    label="Attachments"
    hint="PDF or DOCX, up to 1 MB, at most 3 files"
    accept=".pdf,.docx"
    max-file-size="1048576"
    max-files="3"
    multiple
  ></sl-file-drop>

  <sl-alert variant="danger" closable style="margin-top: 1rem;">
    <sl-icon slot="icon" name="exclamation-octagon"></sl-icon>
    <span class="file-drop-rules__message"></span>
  </sl-alert>
</div>

<script>
  const container = document.querySelector('.file-drop-rules');
  const fileDrop = container.querySelector('sl-file-drop');
  const alert = container.querySelector('sl-alert');
  const reasons = { type: 'file type not allowed', size: 'larger than 1 MB', count: 'too many files' };

  fileDrop.addEventListener('sl-file-reject', event => {
    alert.querySelector('.file-drop-rules__message').textContent = event.detail.rejections
      .map(({ file, reason }) => `${file.name}: ${reasons[reason]}`)
      .join(' · ');
    alert.show();
  });
</script>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/alert/alert.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/file-drop/file-drop.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/icon/icon.js';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA, ElementRef, signal, viewChild } from '@angular/core';
import type SlAlert from '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/alert/alert.component.js';

const REASONS: Record<string, string> = {
  type: 'file type not allowed',
  size: 'larger than 1 MB',
  count: 'too many files'
};

@Component({
  selector: 'app-file-drop-rules-example',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-file-drop
      label="Attachments"
      hint="PDF or DOCX, up to 1 MB, at most 3 files"
      accept=".pdf,.docx"
      max-file-size="1048576"
      max-files="3"
      multiple
      (sl-file-reject)="onReject($event)"
    ></sl-file-drop>

    <sl-alert #alert variant="danger" closable style="margin-top: 1rem;">
      <sl-icon slot="icon" name="exclamation-octagon"></sl-icon>
      <span>{{ message() }}</span>
    </sl-alert>
  `
})
export class FileDropRulesExampleComponent {
  private readonly alert = viewChild.required<ElementRef<SlAlert>>('alert');
  readonly message = signal('');

  onReject(event: Event) {
    const { rejections } = (event as CustomEvent<{ rejections: { file: File; reason: string }[] }>).detail;
    this.message.set(rejections.map(({ file, reason }) => `${file.name}: ${REASONS[reason]}`).join(' · '));
    void this.alert().nativeElement.show();
  }
}
```

### Single file

Without `multiple`, each new file replaces the previous one. Use it for things like importing the signed version of a
letter.

```html
<sl-file-drop label="Signed version" hint="PDF only" accept=".pdf,application/pdf"></sl-file-drop>
```

### Uploading

The file drop doesn't upload anything itself. Listen for `sl-change`, read `files`, and call `clear()` once the upload
has finished.

```html
<div class="file-drop-upload">
  <sl-file-drop label="Attachments" multiple></sl-file-drop>
  <sl-button variant="primary" style="margin-top: 1rem;" disabled>Upload</sl-button>
</div>

<script>
  const container = document.querySelector('.file-drop-upload');
  const fileDrop = container.querySelector('sl-file-drop');
  const button = container.querySelector('sl-button');

  fileDrop.addEventListener('sl-change', () => {
    button.disabled = fileDrop.files.length === 0;
  });

  button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    button.loading = true;
    // Replace with your upload, e.g. a fetch() with a FormData body
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
    button.loading = false;
    button.disabled = true;
    fileDrop.clear();
  });
</script>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/button/button.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/file-drop/file-drop.js';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA, ElementRef, signal, viewChild } from '@angular/core';
import type SlFileDrop from '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/file-drop/file-drop.component.js';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-file-drop-upload-example',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-file-drop #drop label="Attachments" multiple (sl-change)="syncButton()"></sl-file-drop>
    <sl-button
      variant="primary"
      style="margin-top: 1rem;"
      [disabled]="!hasFiles()"
      [loading]="uploading()"
      (click)="upload()"
    >
      Upload
    </sl-button>
  `
})
export class FileDropUploadExampleComponent {
  private readonly drop = viewChild.required<ElementRef<SlFileDrop>>('drop');
  readonly hasFiles = signal(false);
  readonly uploading = signal(false);

  syncButton() {
    this.hasFiles.set(this.drop().nativeElement.files.length > 0);
  }

  async upload() {
    this.uploading.set(true);
    // Replace with your upload, e.g. a fetch() with a FormData body
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
    this.uploading.set(false);
    this.drop().nativeElement.clear();
    this.hasFiles.set(false);
  }
}
```

### Localization

Use the `instructions` slot to translate the text inside the zone, and `remove-label` for the remove buttons.

```html
<sl-file-drop label="Allegati" hint="PDF o DOCX, massimo 20 MB" remove-label="Rimuovi" multiple>
  <span slot="instructions"><strong>Sfoglia</strong> o trascina qui i file</span>
</sl-file-drop>
```

### Disabled

```html
<sl-file-drop label="Attachments" hint="Check in the document to add attachments" disabled></sl-file-drop>
```
